questions.question: Will AI-generated product descriptions hurt my SEO or get me penalized by Google?
questions.answer_summary: Google doesn't issue a direct penalty for duplicate or AI-written descriptions in normal cases, but it may deduplicate/deprioritize near-identical text and only issues manual action for 'spammy auto-generated content' published unedited at scale.

questions.question: How do I avoid duplicate product descriptions when generating them with AI across many SKUs?
questions.answer_summary: Feed the model distinct structured attributes per SKU and vary prompts/angles rather than reusing manufacturer copy verbatim.

questions.question: Are AI-written descriptions actually accurate, or do they oversell products and cause returns?
questions.answer_summary: Sellers on eBay's forums report AI descriptions often use generic 'cheesy' language and can misstate details, which they say leads to negative feedback and more returns.

questions.question: What's the difference between typing into ChatGPT directly vs using a dedicated bulk description app?
questions.answer_summary: Dedicated Shopify apps (e.g. Power Bulk ChatGPT Description, ChatGPT AI Description – Bulk) wrap the same underlying model with catalog-aware bulk generation, SEO metadata, and one-click publishing that raw ChatGPT use doesn't offer.

questions.question: Can AI generate a product description just from a product photo?
questions.answer_summary: Yes — both Amazon's seller-side generative AI tool and eBay's 'Magical Listing' feature can extract product details from images to draft descriptions and titles.

questions.question: How much human editing does AI-generated product copy actually need before publishing?
questions.answer_summary: Guidance converges on a human-in-the-loop model: AI drafts from structured data, a human then checks facts, brand voice, and conversion framing before it goes live.

questions.question: Do buyers notice or care when a listing was clearly written by AI?
questions.answer_summary: eBay seller-community sentiment is that buyers do notice generic AI phrasing and it can read as the seller not knowing their own product.

questions.question: What structured product data do I need before AI can generate good descriptions?
questions.answer_summary: Enterprise guidance stresses rich structured attributes (materials, dimensions, use-case data) as the input AI needs to produce accurate, differentiated copy rather than generic filler.

questions.question: How should product descriptions differ for AI shopping assistants (like ChatGPT/Perplexity shopping) vs. traditional Google SEO?
questions.answer_summary: A 2026 guide argues descriptions for AI shopping agents need explicit structured attributes and FAQ-style content the agent can parse, not just keyword-optimized prose for human search.

questions.question: Is it safe to publish raw, unedited AI descriptions across an entire catalog?
questions.answer_summary: Multiple SEO sources warn that publishing unreviewed AI text at scale risks being flagged as low-quality/spammy auto-generated content even though isolated duplicate descriptions aren't penalized.

questions.question: What's Amazon's own official generative AI tool for sellers and how does it work?
questions.answer_summary: Amazon introduced a generative AI tool letting sellers produce descriptions, titles, and bullet points from a short input, aimed at reducing listing-creation time.

questions.question: How is AI product-content use expected to evolve for ecommerce brands through 2026?
questions.answer_summary: Industry write-ups describe a shift from single-task description generation toward 'agentic' catalog-wide content production (titles, bullets, FAQs, structured attributes) at the pace the digital shelf demands.
